Who We Are

Built on Quality,
Service & Craft

North America Landscaping & Irrigation is your complete outdoor solution for Westchester County. From lush lawn installations and intricate masonry to full irrigation systems and drainage, we bring expertise to every property we touch.

Every project begins with listening — understanding what you want and delivering results that exceed expectations. Our team is highly trained, detail-oriented, and committed to transparent communication at every step.
